newsitem.title: FRANCE: All-cargo aircraft share of Paris 96 traffic rises.
newsitem.headline: All-cargo aircraft share of Paris 96 traffic rises.

text.p: Full-freighters share of global air cargo traffic handled at the Paris airports in 1996 was up 0.4 percentage points on the previous year, Aeroports de Paris (ADP) figures show.
Full-freighters had a 39.4 percent share of the ADP's 1996 global air cargo throughput (imports and exports) totalling 1,112,482 tonnes, compared to 39.0 percent in 1995.
The volume of airfreight handled at CDG and Orly airports transported by full-freighter aircraft was up 2.2 percent on 1995 levels.
